results.name: 011 backfills 5000/8000/6000 to 8000 and archives the original 19000 without changing identity, SQK, inventory, runs or ledger
a lower, tied, then higher run only changes the best on the higher score; growth still accumulates
pending rewards compare each paid run independently and settlement retries cannot sum runs into the best
terminal state transitions and duplicate run updates cannot credit score or growth twice
existing 010 replay hashes/checkpoints continue with engine 1; new runs select engine 2
both leaderboard RPCs rank single-run bests and expose no wallet identifiers
same wallet with a different verified Auth UUID recovers the original profile and personal best
retention, private RLS/grants, server-only commit and all owner verification queries remain enforced
forged score events and another wallet run are rejected by authoritative validation
real game controls save a run once, survive offline reload and disconnect/reconnect, and a tied run leaves the best unchanged
prepared upgrade from inspected 010 applies only 011 and rejects reapplying to 011
unreconstructable positive totals roll back the entire migration without changing player data
historical rules 2/3 HP/completion records reconstruct their actual per-run points

limitations: Disposable PGlite PostgreSQL with explicit Auth/HTTP fixtures; no hosted SQL or real wallet signatures.
Large score examples are administrative test fixtures. Gameplay/reconnect tests separately use the real engine and replay.
Concurrent statements are serialized by the local harness; independent PostgreSQL connections were not tested.
